semaev.title: Summation polynomials and the discrete logarithm problem on elliptic curves
semaev.author: Igor Semaev

semaev_scope: Theorem1,p2 arbitrary split; retained original full-six-page read; no claim of full all-arity irreducibility proof here.

kosters_yeo.read_scope: Section2 p3 general b-invariant S3 formula and Proposition2.1, including visual PDF inspection; not a claim to audit all r, NP-completeness or first-fall results.

new_read_scope: Section2/p3 actual general b-invariant formula and recursion reread in text and visually in PDF.
mathlib: Polynomial fixed-size resultant/map, polynomial ring maps/evaluation; Weierstrass b-invariant definitions/map and b_relation.
argument_order: Ordered helper yields S4(x,y,z,U); actual-curve S4 middle swap and cyclic rotation prove source S4(z,x,y,U). Arbitrary independent b-coefficients have a direct rational cross-symmetry counterexample.
